title: Universal Life Insurance Service Timing Standard: End of the Earnings Period on Refunded Guideline Excess
content:
The earnings period on guideline excess refunded from an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy ends on a date that follows what else stands on the policy. The excess payment is the most recent premium payment in the activity history.

## Timing standard

1. **Surrender on file.** Where a surrender request signed by the owner and approved is on file for the policy, earnings end on that request's received date, the date the surrender is effective.
2. **No surrender on file, excess received more than 60 days ago.** Where no such surrender request is on file and the excess payment was received more than **60** days ago (the compliance days), earnings end on the sixtieth day after receipt.
3. **Otherwise.** Earnings end on the refund date.

The earnings days are the days from the earnings start date to the earnings end date.

## Decision table

| Approved, owner-signed surrender request on file | Days since the excess payment was received | Earnings end on |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | The surrender request's received date |
| No | More than 60 | The sixtieth day after receipt |
| No | 60 or fewer | The refund date |

## Hypothetical readings (excess received by EFT on 1 March, so earnings start on 1 March)

| Situation | Earnings end | Earnings days |
|---|---|---|
| Refunded 20 April, no surrender request | 20 April (refund date) | 50 |
| Refunded 30 April, no surrender request (60 days after receipt) | 30 April (refund date) | 60 |
| Refunded 15 June, no surrender request | 30 April (sixtieth day after receipt) | 60 |
| Refunded 15 June, approved surrender request received 2 June | 2 June | 93 |
